# Grey Heron

The grey heron stands still in shallow water.[^coastal-birds] It feeds by
[wading](../concepts/wading.md); see also [Wading](/wiki/concepts/wading.md) and the
[guide summary](/wiki/summaries/coastal-birds.md#herons).

Other links: [this page](/wiki/entities/grey-heron.md), [habitat](#habitat),
[a missing page](/wiki/entities/missing-bird.md), [an external page](https://example.com/herons),
and a link in code: `[Trip Notes](/sources/journal/trip-notes/trip-notes.md)`.

## Habitat

Tidal flats.
